integrity: The universal statement is supported by explicit elementary-collapse certificates for all 17 facets and an independently replayed verifier using exact set operations. Literature-based originality is not a proof of bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The result is for one specified labelled minimal triangulation. It does not classify the other six minimal dunce-hat triangulations, all collapse orders, or all possible terminal cycles.
title: Every facet puncture of the minimal eight-vertex dunce hat collapses to a circle
